# Copilot Custom Instructions

## Project Overview
Android Banking Application with Card Details main screen using Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3.

## Project Structure
- Language: Kotlin
- UI Framework: Jetpack Compose
- Minimum SDK: 24
- Target SDK: 34

## Development Guidelines
1. Use Jetpack Compose for all UI components
2. Follow Material Design 3 principles
3. Keep composables modular and reusable
4. Use state management with ViewModel for complex screens
5. Add proper error handling and validation

## Build & Run
- Sync Gradle: `Build > Clean Project`
- Run: `Run > Run 'app'`
- Build APK: `Build > Build Bundle(s) / APK(s) > Build APK(s)`
